title: Quality Studio inside Agent Studio
summary: Concept for Robert's request of 1 November 2026: Quality Studio as an area of Agent Studio with a project jump, a Quality panel per card for exactly its change set, and no second sign-in, while both products stay usable alone. Verified against Agent Studio a3b98b11b and Quality Studio 7dd46b54. Recommends: Quality Studio as an opt-in service in the moved Studio's compose stack under its own sibling hostname, not under a Studio path; sign-in by a 60-second single-use signed hand-off delivered in a POST body (OIDC-shaped, OIDC later); a Deck Quality-group row and an Explorer row; a stored project-to-repository mapping with automatic registration; the card change set merge-base..Result-SHA per delivery round with a landed-range note; one verdict in which Quality Studio decides the code-quality aspect of Agent Studio's review (QS-W31 option B), computed once on the Review Plane and stored on both sides; a versioned contract agent-studio-integration/1 with capabilities and N/N-1 support; repository writes from hosted Quality Studio become cards. Compares four hosting and sign-in options and three verdict models. Ten decisions with recommendations; eight slices, the first being the project jump on the moved Studio.

implementationTasks.title: Agent Studio: project jump to Quality Studio on the moved Studio
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
Read `docs/quality-studio-integration/index.html` and `docs/quality-studio-integration/workbench.json`, AGENTS.md, frontend/AGENTS.md for UI work, and docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html. This is one bounded slice of the AGT-3352 Dossier, target project **Agent Studio** (PROJ-002). Use the Dossier's recommended option for every decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another, and record in results/status.md which option you implemented. Git handling stays with the platform: do not commit, push or manage worktrees yourself.

## Goal
A signed-in Studio user on the public Studio (`robert.omgai.dev`, networked profile) opens the project's Quality Studio repository dashboard in a new tab with one click and no second sign-in (Dossier sections 02 and 03, decisions D1, D3, D4 option C).

## Scope
- Compose: add Quality Studio as opt-in profile `quality` to `deploy/compose/monolith-networked/compose.yaml`, on the existing bridge network with its own IP, no published port, hosted mode, trusted proxy = edge IP, data volume under `/srv/agent-studio/quality`, the runner checkout root bind-mounted read-only at the identical path. Add a site block for `QUALITY_DOMAIN` (default `quality-<studio host>`) to every edge Caddyfile mode, using the same Cloudflare origin-pull rules as the Studio site. Document the profile in `docs/operations/setup/move-studio-to-server.md` and `studio-website.md`.
- Connection settings: Settings › Integrations › Quality Studio (Owner only): internal base URL, public URL, service client id; the service token is a `secret://workspace/quality-studio/api-token` reference in the secret provider, never appsettings. Status probe reads `GET /api/v1/capabilities`.
- Hand-off issuer: an Ed25519 signing key in the secret provider; public key set at `/.well-known/agent-studio/jwks.json`; route `GET /api/integrations/quality-studio/open?project=<id>[&return=<relative QS path>]` that checks session, project read right and mapping, signs the assertion (iss, aud, sub, sid, role, repos, target, jti, iat, exp = iat + 60 s, ver 1) and returns a self-submitting HTML form to `https://<QUALITY_DOMAIN>/auth/agent-studio` with the assertion in the body. Response headers: `Cache-Control: no-store`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, a nonce CSP with `form-action` limited to the Quality Studio origin and `frame-ancestors 'none'`. Validate `return` as a relative path. Add `handoff` to `CredentialRedactor`.
- Revoke: on logout, password change, role change and user removal, call `POST /api/v1/federation/revoke` through a durable outbox with bounded retries.
- UI: a `quality-studio` row in the Deck Quality group (`project-shell.config.ts`) opening a status panel with the states of the Dossier's jump table (not connected, unreachable, version too old, not registered, ready) and an "Open in Quality Studio" button (new tab, `noopener`). Add a Quality Studio row to the Explorer project children using the existing external-open affordance. Viewers and operators do not see the row when the integration is not configured; Owners see "Not connected". Mapping comes from project setting `qualityStudio.repositoryId`, settable by an Owner in the panel until QSI-4 automates it.

## Out of scope
Automatic registration (QSI-4), card panel (QSI-6), Quality Studio code (QSI-2).

## Acceptance criteria
- On the moved Studio (or the `--rehearse` stack on 127.0.0.1:18443) with QSI-2 deployed, a signed-in operator clicks Deck › Quality Studio › Open for a mapped project and sees that repository's Quality Studio dashboard in a new tab without any credential prompt; p95 from click to dashboard render at most 3 s over 20 tries.
- A HAR of the flow contains the assertion only in the form response body and the POST body: no URL, Referer, Location or query string contains it, and a grep of Caddy, Studio and Quality Studio logs for the assertion value returns zero matches.
- Replaying the captured POST body a second time, or after 60 s, is refused by Quality Studio; a `return` value that is absolute or protocol-relative is refused by Studio.
- The Quality Studio container publishes no host port (`docker compose ps`), and with the `quality` profile off the Studio stack starts unchanged.
- Playwright covers the five panel states and the Explorer row in light and dark themes; backend tests cover claims, expiry, project rights and redaction; logout triggers one revoke call that survives a Quality Studio restart.

implementationTasks.title: Quality Studio: Agent Studio sign-in, capabilities and deep link v1
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
Read `docs/quality-studio-integration/index.html` in the Agent Studio repository (agent-orc/agent-studio, PROJ-002) and this repository's docs/deployment.md, docs/change-reviews.md, docs/api.md and AGENTS.md. This is one bounded slice of the AGT-3352 Dossier, target project **Quality Studio** (PROJ-016). Use the Dossier's recommended option for every decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another, and record in results/status.md which option you implemented. Git handling stays with the platform: do not commit, push or manage worktrees yourself. Local mode and bearer-token hosted mode must keep working unchanged.

## Goal
Quality Studio accepts a signed hand-off from a configured Agent Studio, opens its own browser session, and declares its integration contract (Dossier sections 02, 03, 06; decisions D4 option C, D10 option a).

## Scope
- Configuration `AgentStudio:Federation:Issuer`, `Audience`, `JwksUrl` (or pinned keys), `StudioPublicUrl`. Without it, `/auth/agent-studio` answers 404.
- `POST /auth/agent-studio` (form body `handoff`): verify EdDSA signature against the issuer's key set, `aud`, `exp` (60 s, 30 s clock skew), `ver`, `Origin` equal to the Studio origin, and single use of `jti` (persist used ids in the data root until expiry). Create a session `__Host-qs-session` (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, idle 60 min, absolute 12 h) bound to `sub`, `sid`, `role` and `repos`, then 303 to `target` (relative only). Never log the body.
- Session callers: authorize per repository from `repos`; viewer read-only, operator adds finding states, reviews and handover, owner adds registration and rule pool. Require a CSRF header from the existing frontend for unsafe methods and check `Origin`. Session callers do not need `X-Client-Id`; fix the frontend so bearer-token hosted mode sends `X-Client-Id` for mutations as well (today it never does).
- Without a session in federated mode, redirect page loads to `<StudioPublicUrl>/api/integrations/quality-studio/open?project=<from externalRef or repo>&return=<relative path>`.
- `POST /api/v1/federation/revoke` (service client only) ends sessions by `sid` or `sub`.
- `GET /api/v1/capabilities`: product version, `contracts: ["agent-studio-integration/1"]`, features (`federation`, `deep-link/1`, later `external-ref`, `change-review-store`), and whether spend routes have a provider. Alias the integration routes under `/api/v1/` without removing the old paths.
- Deep link v1: document the parameters from the Dossier's table in docs/api.md; `view=dashboard` and unknown views open the repository dashboard; `card` renders a "Back to <key>" link to `StudioPublicUrl`.
- Container: `safe.directory` for the mounted repository root so Git reads checkouts owned by another uid.

## Acceptance criteria
- A valid assertion produces a session and a 303 to the relative target; expired, wrong audience, wrong Origin, reused jti, unknown `ver` and absolute targets are each refused with a test.
- A session with role viewer cannot change a finding state (403) and cannot reach a repository outside `repos` (404); an operator can, and the spend rate limit counts per user.
- Local mode and bearer hosted mode pass their existing test suites unchanged; a bearer-token browser in hosted mode can now change a finding state (regression test for the missing X-Client-Id).
- `/api/v1/capabilities` validates against a new JSON Schema in schemas/, and revoke ends a session within one request.
- Git reads a read-only checkout owned by another uid inside the container (integration test or scripted container check).

implementationTasks.title: Quality Studio: external references on repository registrations
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
Read `docs/quality-studio-integration/index.html` in the Agent Studio repository (agent-orc/agent-studio, PROJ-002) and this repository's docs/deployment.md, docs/change-reviews.md, docs/api.md and AGENTS.md. Use the Dossier's recommended option for every decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another, and record in results/status.md which option you implemented. Git handling stays with the platform: do not commit, push or manage worktrees yourself. Local mode and bearer-token hosted mode must keep working unchanged.

## Goal
Agent Studio can register a repository with a stable external reference and find it again without matching paths (decision D2 option M2).

## Scope
- Add optional `externalRefs: [{ system: "agent-studio", id: "PROJ-002", url? }]` to `RepositoryRegistrationRequest`, the registry file and the repository DTOs. Unique per `system:id`.
- `GET /api/v1/repos?externalRef=agent-studio:PROJ-002` returns at most one repository; registrations whose path does not exist yet are refused with a typed reason (`root-missing`) so the caller can retry.
- Keep path-as-identity for everything else; document the field in docs/api.md and docs/data-root.md; announce feature `external-ref` in capabilities.

## Acceptance criteria
- Registering two repositories with the same external reference is refused with 409; lookup by external reference returns the right repository and 404 when absent.
- A registration for a missing root returns the typed reason `root-missing`, and a later retry with the same id succeeds once the directory exists.
- Existing registrations without external references load unchanged; schema and API docs are updated.

implementationTasks.title: Agent Studio: automatic Quality Studio registration and stored mapping
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
Read `docs/quality-studio-integration/index.html` and `docs/quality-studio-integration/workbench.json`, AGENTS.md, frontend/AGENTS.md for UI work, and docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html. Use the Dossier's recommended option for every decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another, and record in results/status.md which option you implemented. Git handling stays with the platform: do not commit, push or manage worktrees yourself.

## Goal
Every Studio project gets a Quality Studio repository without manual work, and every Studio call uses a stored mapping instead of exact path matching (decision D2 option M2).

## Scope
- After project creation in `RegistryEndpoints` (non-blocking, failure never fails creation), register through the service client: id = lowercase project id (`proj-002`), display name, canonical checkout path on the Quality Studio host from a configurable template (default `${RUNNER_WORKDIR}/{projectId}/repo`), `externalRefs` `agent-studio:<projectId>`. Store `qualityStudio.repositoryId` and a registration state with reason.
- A reconcile loop every 15 minutes: register missing, retry `root-missing`, backfill all projects when the integration is first connected, archive on project archive, and adopt an existing registration found by external reference.
- Switch `QualityAnalysisStepRunner` and `runner/CoverageRunCommand.cs` to the stored repository id; keep exact path matching only as a fallback for unconnected local installs and log when it is used.
- The Deck panel's "Register now" (Owner) triggers one reconcile for that project.

## Acceptance criteria
- Creating a project with Quality Studio connected yields a registration within one reconcile cycle; with Quality Studio down, the project is still created and the panel shows 'Not registered' with the reason.
- A project whose checkout appears after creation is registered on the next cycle without operator action; archiving a project archives its registration.
- The analysis step and coverage run reach the right repository when Quality Studio sees the checkout under a different path (test with a mapped id and a non-matching rootPath).
- Unit tests cover idempotent registration, adoption by external reference and the non-blocking failure path.

implementationTasks.title: Quality Studio: change-review store, ingest and change view
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
Read `docs/quality-studio-integration/index.html` in the Agent Studio repository (agent-orc/agent-studio, PROJ-002) and this repository's docs/deployment.md, docs/change-reviews.md, docs/api.md and AGENTS.md. This is one bounded slice of the AGT-3352 Dossier, target project **Quality Studio** (PROJ-016). Use the Dossier's recommended option for every decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another, and record in results/status.md which option you implemented. Git handling stays with the platform: do not commit, push or manage worktrees yourself. Local mode and bearer-token hosted mode must keep working unchanged.

## Goal
A verdict for a commit range is computed at most once, can be ingested from Agent Studio, and can be opened at a deep link (decisions D5, D7 option a).

## Scope
- Persist change-review verdict documents in the data root, keyed by repository, `baseSha`, `headSha`, `policyHash`, `ruleSetHash`, `catalogueVersion`, with producer provenance (`quality-studio` or `agent-studio-review-plane`, card key, round, attempt id).
- `PUT /api/v1/repos/{id}/change-reviews` (service client): idempotent ingest of a `change-review-verdict.v1` document plus provenance; unknown schema versions answer 422.
- `GET /api/v1/repos/{id}/change-reviews?base=&head=` returns the stored documents for the range, newest rule set first.
- `POST /api/repos/{id}/change-review`: look up the key first and return the stored document without a model call; store every new result.
- UI: `view=change&base=&head=[&card=]` shows verdict, severity counts, findings anchored to the diff, provenance and "this round only" when a previous head is given; a range without a verdict shows "Not reviewed" and an operator-only "Run review" (spend route). A SHA missing from the checkout shows "commit not present on this host".
- Announce `change-review-store` in capabilities; document the store in docs/change-reviews.md.

## Acceptance criteria
- A second `POST change-review` for the same key makes no model call (provider fake asserts zero invocations) and returns the identical document.
- Ingesting the same document twice stores one record; a document with an unknown schemaVersion is refused with 422.
- The change view renders a stored verdict, the 'Not reviewed' state and the missing-commit state, with a frontend test for each.
- Infrastructure verdicts (`provider-unavailable`, `timeout`, `auth-failure`, `unparseable`) render as unavailable, never as pass.

implementationTasks.title: Agent Studio: card change set and Quality panel
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
Read `docs/quality-studio-integration/index.html` and `docs/quality-studio-integration/workbench.json`, AGENTS.md, frontend/AGENTS.md for UI work, and docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html. Use the Dossier's recommended option for every decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another, and record in results/status.md which option you implemented. Git handling stays with the platform: do not commit, push or manage worktrees yourself.

## Goal
Every reviewed card shows its Quality verdict for exactly its change set and jumps to that range in Quality Studio (Dossier section 04, decisions D5 option a, D6 option V2, D7 option a, D8 option a). Requires QSI-1, QSI-5 and the QS-W31 Review Plane code-quality step with its off, shadow and decide switch.

## Scope
- Change-set projection per card and round: repository id, `base` = merge-base(integration ref, ResultSha) as used by Remote Review (record it in the review material if it is not stored yet), `head` = ResultSha, round = DeliveryGeneration, attempt id, commit count excluding superseded commits, and after integration the landed SHA and whether the landed patch equals the reviewed patch (patch-id comparison).
- Store the Review Plane's verdict document as a card artifact and push it through the durable outbox to `PUT /api/v1/repos/{id}/change-reviews` (7-day bounded retry, then an operator-feed event).
- Quality panel at the top of the Evidence tab (above Review evidence; move `quality-studio:*` rows into it so nothing appears twice) with the states from Dossier figure 5: not registered, waiting, reviewing, pass, concerns, block, unavailable, shadow, outdated, not reviewed. Severity counts, top three findings, 'new since round N', round switcher, landed note, and 'Open this range in Quality Studio' through the QSI-1 open route with `view=change&base&head&card`.
- One verdict line on the human decision surface. A board card dot only for Block in review lanes (R4). Use existing tokens, badge and row components; no left accent bars.
- The panel never calls `change-review`.

## Acceptance criteria
- For a card with two delivery rounds the panel shows round 2 by default with base = merge-base and head = round-2 ResultSha, round 1 stays selectable, and both ranges match `git merge-base` and the Result-SHAs in a fixture repository.
- After a --no-ff integration the panel shows the landed SHA and 'landed patch equals reviewed patch'; a fixture with a conflict resolution shows the 'differs' note and a landed-range jump.
- No code path from the card panel or the jump calls `POST change-review` (test with a Quality Studio fake that fails on that route).
- Playwright covers pass, concerns, block, unavailable, shadow and not-registered in light and dark themes, and the board Block dot appears only for Block in review lanes.
- Outbox delivery is idempotent across a Quality Studio restart and stops after 7 days with one operator-feed event.

implementationTasks.title: Quality Studio: repository writes become Agent Studio cards in integrated hosted mode
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
Read `docs/quality-studio-integration/index.html` in the Agent Studio repository (agent-orc/agent-studio, PROJ-002) and this repository's docs/deployment.md, docs/change-reviews.md, docs/api.md and AGENTS.md. This is one bounded slice of the AGT-3352 Dossier, target project **Quality Studio** (PROJ-016). Use the Dossier's recommended option for every decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another, and record in results/status.md which option you implemented. Git handling stays with the platform: do not commit, push or manage worktrees yourself. Local mode and bearer-token hosted mode must keep working unchanged.

## Goal
In hosted mode with Agent Studio federation configured, Quality Studio never writes into a repository checkout; changes to repository-owned files become Agent Studio cards (decision D9 option a).

## Scope
- Identify every route that writes repository-owned files (`.quality/findings/suppressions.json`, `.quality/rules/`, policy files) and route them, in integrated hosted mode, to the existing handover client (`POST /api/tasks`) as a card with the exact patch, the acting user and the reason. Dry-run stays the default until the operator enables live handover.
- The UI shows 'Requested as AGT-123' with a link back to the Studio card instead of 'Saved'.
- Local mode and non-federated hosted mode keep writing as today.
- Data-root writes (finding state ledger, review runs, change-review store) are not repository writes and stay local.

## Acceptance criteria
- In integrated hosted mode with a read-only checkout, adding a suppression creates exactly one handover card (or dry-run record) with the patch and leaves the checkout unchanged.
- Local mode still writes the suppression file directly (existing tests pass).
- A test enumerates all repository-writing routes and fails when a new one bypasses the integrated-mode rule.
